title: Sottile Theater

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: We're proud to offer the Sottile Theatre and Barnet Courtyard as some of the finest venues in downtown Charleston, South Carolina. Hold requests will be accepted up to 12 months in advance for any available dates. Any requests more than one year in advance will be considered tentative. All hold requests must be made via the Rental Request Form available on the Sottile website. All hold requests will be valid for 30 days or until challenged by another client. After 30 days, a client must sign a contract and provide full payment for all deposits and advance fees.
